title: SXT-020 patch image header (container segment at offset 12)
description: Identity + provenance segment of a patch image. Canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' ':', ensure_ascii, allow_nan=false), UTF-8. The container checksum (SHA-256 hex over the whole preceding container) and header.body_sha256 (SHA-256 hex over the canonical body bytes) are the two corruption-detection layers; normalized_graph_sha256 pins the exact source graph. No timestamps or machine-dependent values anywhere.

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical body bytes (checksum layer 1).

path.description: Census path of the source .fxp (identical to corpus-manifest entries[].path).

census_blob_sha1.description: Git blob SHA-1 of the source .fxp, re-verified against graphs.jsonl by the golden suite.

size_bytes.description: Source .fxp size in bytes when the graph line carries it.

pin.description: Repeated per image so every image is independently checkable against the SXT-010/SXT-011 pin.

normalized_graph_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex over canonical_json(g) of the source graph. verify.py rebuilds g from the body's verbatim graph sections and requires an exact hash match (losslessness).

profile.description: The DRAFT profile the gates were evaluated against. Never frozen in format v1 images.

bundle_file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole bundle spec file; pins the exact gate vocabulary.

bundle_spec.description: The validated spec object for bundle_id (allowlists, limits, budgets, gap policies), embedded verbatim.

claim_scope.description: Standing note: a compiled image is not a support, fidelity, or preset-quality claim.

checksum_layers: container digest: SHA-256 hex over bytes [0, 12+header_len+body_len) — detects any corruption anywhere
header.body_sha256: SHA-256 hex over the canonical body bytes — the strong canonical-body hash
header.normalized_graph_sha256: SHA-256 hex over canonical_json(rebuilt graph) — lossless round-trip vs the SXT-011 source graph
